images.description: Root-relative same-origin listing photographs, at most five.

contentBase64.description: Base64-encoded evidence bytes. Size and checksum are derived server-side.

publicationId.description: Public request publication id. The offer endpoints are keyed by it, never by the request id. Absent until the request is published, which means it is still awaiting moderation and cannot receive offers yet.

publicationStatus.description: Publication lifecycle state. Present only together with publicationId.

moderationStatus.description: Moderation decision on the publication. Present only together with publicationId.

deliveryPriceUzs.description: Zero for pickup, positive for seller_delivery, and absent for by_agreement.
Required when deliveryTerms is seller_delivery; must be omitted for pickup and by_agreement.

buyerProfileId.description: Opaque public profile address of the buying organization, so a deal screen can link to the counterparty. It is derived, carries no partner, user or tenant identifier, and resolves only while that party keeps a moderated public presence.

sellerProfileId.description: Opaque public profile address of the selling organization.

subject.description: The reviewed seller. Present only on reviews this profile wrote, never on reviews it received.

id.description: Opaque public profile address. Never a user, tenant or partner identifier.

sellerId.description: Public seller address, when this party publishes a catalog.

activationReference.description: Internal activation audit reference. The charge itself lives in the promotion_billing provider operation ledger, not here.

actingPartnerId.description: Approved seller organization used for this command.
